prompt.what: a rose-red layered rock bank with a cluster of hexagonal cyan silicate crystal columns, three loose small crystals, one grey-brown boulder; a tilted federal A-frame sample rack (beige tubes, charcoal caps, orange rings, a hanging charcoal core box with a beige panel); three steel-grey drill cores
prompt.colors: rose-red rock #C7475F (lower terracotta band #C2583F, NOT purple, NOT grey), grey-brown boulder #8C7272, cyan crystal #4FE3D8 with white top highlight #B8F7F2 and an opaque grey core patch #6E7580 on the lower half of each face, beige rack #DCC8B3, neutral charcoal caps and box #535556 (NOT navy), orange stripe #CA7610, steel-grey cores #6A6C6E, one pale cut end #E9B99A. Brush blocks are the SAME base colour a little lighter or deeper, never blue, violet or warm-tinted

extra.m1_00: ROCK: each tier one flat rose-red base; on a few tiers add one or two broad flat slightly lighter rose-red brush blocks (slanted rectangles or wedges) along the top break of the tier, the rest stays plain; NO darkening in the gaps between tiers; the lower band flat terracotta; NO cracks, NO strata texture, NO speckles. CRYSTAL: each prism face flat cyan; the top cut face is the designed near-white #B8F7F2; on a few faces one slanted flat lighter cyan block along the face edge (not on every edge); on the LOWER HALF of each visible face ONE opaque, jagged-edged mid-grey ore-core patch (flat grey, crisp edge); NO glow, NO transparency, NO dark outline. BOULDER: flat grey-brown with one broad lighter block on its upper plane and one single darker groove line. RACK / CORES: beige, neutral charcoal, flat orange, steel grey, each with at most one flat brush block along a rail; cores' cut end flat pale peach.
